name: permission-prompts
description: Observations of agent permission prompts in a pseudo terminal of 120 columns and 40 rows: the screen while the prompt is open, after a bracketed paste of an injected message without Enter, and after Enter, with the last OSC 7501 report of the program before each screen. The screens leave out the account, the plan, the usage and the logo rows, and name the scratch folder <scratch>.
